stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about discharge readiness and care coordination.
stem.zh: 查看患者病历，并回答有关出院准备情况和护理协调的病例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: discharge coordination after right total hip arthroplasty
title.zh: 展开病例：右全髋关节置换术后的出院协调

summary.en: An 82-year-old Mandarin-speaking client is recovering from elective right total hip arthroplasty. The nurse must coordinate language access, mobility readiness, medication safety, home health services, and handoff planning before discharge home.
summary.zh: 一名82岁、主要讲普通话的患者正在从择期右全髋关节置换术中恢复。护士必须在患者回家出院前协调语言服务、活动能力准备、用药安全、居家护理服务和交接计划。

title.en: Postoperative day 0: admission record and initial assessment
title.zh: 术后第0天：入院记录和初始评估

content.en:
1530: Mrs. Chen, age 82, is admitted to the orthopedic surgical unit after uncomplicated elective right total hip arthroplasty for osteoarthritis. Primary language: Mandarin. She can exchange simple greetings in English but cannot reliably discuss medications, follow multistep instructions, or read English discharge documents. She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment. Her adult son lives 2 hours away and works full-time. She does not own a smartphone and uses a corded landline at home.

History: hypertension, mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min), and type 2 diabetes. No history of venous thromboembolism.

Orders: rivaroxaban 10 mg PO daily for 35 days for VTE prophylaxis; acetaminophen 1 g PO every 6 hr scheduled; oxycodone 5 mg PO every 4 hr PRN breakthrough pain; home amlodipine and metformin; incentive spirometry every 1-2 hr while awake; sequential compression devices while in bed; physical therapy consult on postoperative day 1; posterior hip precautions: no flexion beyond 90 degrees, no internal rotation, and no adduction past midline.

Initial findings at 1600: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 82, BP 138/78, RR 16, SpO₂ 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Alert and oriented to person and place with interpreter phone assistance. Pain 5/10. Dressing clean, dry, intact; drain output 50 mL sanguineous since OR. Right pedal pulse 2+, capillary refill <3 sec, sensation intact, and dorsiflexion/plantarflexion present. Foley catheter draining clear yellow urine. Call light within reach and bed alarm activated. The nurse observes the client leaning across the bed rail for water, suggesting she may not understand fall-prevention instructions.

Baseline labs: Hgb 10.8 g/dL (pre-op 12.1), Hct 32%, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, WBC 9.2 ×10³/µL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 38 mL/min, K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L, Na⁺ 139 mEq/L, glucose 162 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL.

Chart concern: Mandarin is listed as the primary language. Informed consent was signed with an interpreter present, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented.
content.zh:
1530：陈女士，82岁，因骨关节炎接受择期右全髋关节置换术后入住骨科外科病区，手术过程无并发症。主要语言：普通话。她能用英语进行简单问候，但不能可靠地讨论药物、执行多步骤指令或阅读英文出院文件。她独自住在二楼无电梯公寓。成年儿子住在2小时车程外，并全职工作。她没有智能手机，家中使用有线座机。

病史：高血压、轻度慢性肾病（基础肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min）和2型糖尿病。无静脉血栓栓塞史。

医嘱：利伐沙班10 mg口服每日一次，共35天，用于VTE预防；对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服每6小时定时；羟考酮5 mg口服每4小时按需用于突破性疼痛；继续家庭剂量的氨氯地平和二甲双胍；清醒时每1–2小时使用激励肺量计；卧床时使用序贯加压装置；术后第1天物理治疗会诊；后路髋关节置换注意事项：髋屈曲不超过90度、不得内旋、不得内收越过中线。

1600初始评估：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/78 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 96%（鼻导管2 L）。借助电话解释服务评估，患者能辨认本人和地点。疼痛5/10。敷料清洁、干燥、完整；从手术室至今引流出血性液体50 mL。右足背动脉搏动2+，毛细血管再充盈<3秒，感觉完整，可背屈和跖屈。导尿管引流清亮黄色尿液。呼叫铃在可及范围内，床报警已开启。护士观察到患者越过床栏伸手拿水，提示她可能不理解防跌倒指示。

基础实验室：血红蛋白10.8 g/dL（术前12.1），血细胞比容32%，血小板198 ×10³/µL，白细胞9.2 ×10³/µL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28秒，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 38 mL/min，K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L，Na⁺ 139 mEq/L，血糖162 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL。

病历关注点：病历列明主要语言为普通话。知情同意书在解释员在场时签署，但未记录术后持续语言服务计划。

title.zh: 术后第1天：出院准备筛查

title.en: Morning assessment, PT note, and education attempt
title.zh: 晨间评估、物理治疗记录和健康教育尝试

content.en:
About 18 hr after surgery: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 78, BP 132/74, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Pain 4/10 at rest and 7/10 with movement using an interpreter phone. Drain removed per order; incision approximated with staples, mild ecchymosis, no erythema, and scant serous drainage. Foley removed; client voided 250 mL. Oral medications tolerated.

Repeat labs: Hgb 10.2 g/dL, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, eGFR 36 mL/min, glucose 148 mg/dL.

PT session: Client sits at the edge of the bed and stands with a front-wheeled walker using moderate assistance from two people. She is unsteady, attempts to lift the walker, loses balance once but is caught by PT, and cannot safely rise from a standard-height chair independently. PT documents that she is not safe for discharge home without continued walker training and a home-safety evaluation. PT recommends at least two more sessions and home PT after discharge.

Teaching attempt: The nurse attempts hip-precaution and anticoagulant teaching using an English handout. The client nods and smiles but cannot demonstrate understanding. With interpreter phone assistance, she cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs to report, or what to do if a dose is missed. The nurse documents failed teach-back and the need for a certified Mandarin interpreter for comprehensive discharge teaching.

Unresolved discharge barriers: lives alone with no confirmed support for the first 48-72 hr; unsafe walker use; discharge teaching incomplete because of language barrier; no home health referral; uncertain rivaroxaban adherence; second-floor walk-up with no stair assessment; no confirmed follow-up appointment; creatinine trending upward while receiving a renally cleared anticoagulant.
content.zh:
术后约18小时：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率78次/分，血压132/74 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 97%。通过电话解释服务评估，静息疼痛4/10，活动时疼痛7/10。按医嘱拔除引流管；切口以皮钉闭合，轻度瘀斑，无红斑，少量浆液性渗液。拔除导尿管；患者自行排尿250 mL。可耐受口服药物。

复查实验室：血红蛋白10.2 g/dL，肌酐1.5 mg/dL，eGFR 36 mL/min，血糖148 mg/dL。

物理治疗记录：患者可在床边坐起，并在两人中等协助下使用前轮助行器站立。她步态不稳，试图把助行器抬起，曾失去平衡一次但被物理治疗师扶住，且无法独立安全地从标准高度椅子上站起。物理治疗记录显示，在继续助行器训练和居家安全评估之前，患者尚不适合回家出院。PT建议至少再进行两次训练，并在出院后安排居家物理治疗。

健康教育尝试：护士使用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和抗凝药。患者点头微笑，但不能证明理解。借助电话解释服务，她不能说出药名、用途、需报告的出血征象或漏服后的处理。护士记录回教失败，并记录需要合格普通话医疗解释员进行全面出院教育。

未解决的出院障碍：独居且最初48–72小时无确认照护者；助行器使用不安全；因语言障碍出院教育未完成；未转介居家护理；利伐沙班依从性不确定；二楼无电梯且尚未评估上下楼梯能力；未确认随访预约；正在使用经肾脏清除的抗凝药且肌酐上升。

title.en: Coordination update, renal trend, and teach-back session
title.zh: 协调进展、肾功能趋势和回教环节

content.en:
About 42 hr after surgery: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 128/72, RR 14, SpO₂ 98% on room air. Pain 3/10 at rest and 5/10 with movement. Incision clean with staples intact and no signs of infection. Repeat creatinine 1.4 mg/dL after hydration and adequate oral intake; eGFR 39 mL/min. Hgb 10.0 g/dL.

Social work/case management interviews the client using a telephone interpreter. Her son can be present on the day of discharge and the following day, but not beyond that. She receives Meals on Wheels and has Medicare with a supplemental plan. Case management determines that she qualifies for Medicare home health services because she is homebound and requires skilled nursing plus home PT. The home health referral is initiated.

PT session: Client demonstrates safe walker use on level ground with standby assistance and can perform sit-to-stand from a raised toilet seat independently. Stairs have not yet been attempted. Afternoon PT stair training is planned.

Interpreter-mediated education: A certified in-person Mandarin interpreter is present. The nurse teaches posterior hip precautions, rivaroxaban purpose and 10 mg once-daily schedule for 35 days, bleeding signs, missed-dose instructions, pain medication safety, and when to call the surgeon or seek emergency care. The client accurately repeats key points in Mandarin, demonstrates hip precautions with a model, and identifies the rivaroxaban pill. She states she would need her son to call the surgeon because she cannot navigate the English phone tree alone. The nurse flags this as a remaining barrier.

Afternoon PT: Client negotiates four stairs up and down with a walker and one handrail with standby assistance. PT clears her for discharge home with home PT, front-wheeled walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse requests a Mandarin-translated home exercise program. The surgeon writes a discharge order for postoperative day 3 morning pending nursing confirmation of discharge readiness.
content.zh:
术后约42小时：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率74次/分，血压128/72 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 98%。静息疼痛3/10，活动时5/10。切口清洁，皮钉完整，无感染迹象。补液并充分口服摄入后复查肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 39 mL/min。血红蛋白10.0 g/dL。

社会工作/个案管理通过电话解释员访谈患者。她的儿子可在出院当天和次日陪伴，但之后不能继续陪伴。她接受送餐服务，并有Medicare及补充保险。个案管理判断，由于她居家受限且需要专业护理和居家物理治疗，符合Medicare居家护理服务条件。居家护理转介已启动。

物理治疗：患者在平地使用助行器时仅需旁站协助，可独立从加高马桶座上坐站转换。尚未尝试楼梯。计划下午进行楼梯训练。

解释员参与的健康教育：合格的现场普通话医疗解释员在场。护士讲解后路髋关节注意事项、利伐沙班用途及10 mg每日一次共35天的服药安排、出血征象、漏服处理、止痛药安全，以及何时联系外科医生或急诊就医。患者能用普通话准确复述要点，用模型示范髋关节注意事项，并能辨认利伐沙班药片。她表示若有问题需让儿子致电外科医生，因为她无法独自应对英文电话系统。护士将此标记为剩余障碍。

下午物理治疗：患者在旁站协助下使用助行器和一侧扶手上下四级台阶。PT同意其在安排居家PT、前轮助行器、加高马桶座和取物器后回家出院。护士要求康复部门提供普通话版居家运动计划。外科医生开具术后第3天上午出院医嘱，前提是护士确认出院准备充分。

title.en: Postoperative day 3: final discharge verification and handoff
title.zh: 术后第3天：最终出院核查和交接

content.en:
About 66 hr after surgery: T 98.1 °F (36.7 °C), HR 72, BP 126/70, RR 14, SpO₂ 99% on room air. Pain 2/10 at rest and 4/10 with movement, controlled with scheduled acetaminophen alone; client declined the last two oxycodone doses. Incision clean and dry. Creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min. Hgb 9.8 g/dL and stable. Glucose 132 mg/dL.

Final readiness verification: The Visiting Nurse Association accepts the referral. First home visit for skilled nursing and PT is confirmed for the day after discharge. The nurse calls the receiving home health nurse using SBAR and communicates language needs, the need for an interpreter for teaching, social situation, functional status, equipment, rivaroxaban dose/duration and adherence concerns, renal-function trend, bleeding surveillance, son's role as the communication contact, and the confirmed follow-up appointment. The home health agency confirms that a Mandarin-speaking home health aide is available.

The nurse calls the surgeon's office to confirm the 2-week follow-up appointment and requests that a Mandarin interpreter be scheduled. The son arrives at 0900. With video interpreter assistance, the nurse reviews discharge instructions with the client and son together, confirms that the son understands how to reach the surgeon's office, provides the home health agency phone number, and gives the client a 7-day pill organizer labeled in Mandarin. The client is discharged at 1030 by wheelchair to her son's car with the walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse documents that all identified discharge barriers are resolved or have a confirmed community plan of care.
content.zh:
术后约66小时：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率72次/分，血压126/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 99%。静息疼痛2/10，活动时4/10，仅用定时对乙酰氨基酚即可控制；患者拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。切口清洁干燥。肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min。血红蛋白9.8 g/dL且稳定。血糖132 mg/dL。

最终出院准备核查：访问护士协会接受转介。已确认出院后次日进行首次居家专业护理和物理治疗。护士使用SBAR致电接收的居家护理护士，沟通语言需求、所有教学需使用解释员、社会情况、功能状态、设备、利伐沙班剂量/疗程及依从性关注点、肾功能趋势、出血监测、儿子作为沟通联系人，以及已确认的随访预约。居家护理机构确认可安排会普通话的居家护理助理。

护士致电外科医生办公室确认2周随访预约，并要求安排普通话解释员。儿子于0900到达。护士借助视频解释员与患者和儿子共同复习出院说明，确认儿子知道如何联系外科医生办公室，提供居家护理机构电话号码，并给患者一盒以普通话标注的7天药盒。患者于1030坐轮椅至儿子的汽车，助行器、加高马桶座和取物器一并带走。护士记录所有已识别的出院障碍均已解决，或已有确认的社区照护计划。

stem.en: Postoperative day 0: The admission record lists Mandarin as the client's primary language, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented. Which action should the nurse take first?
stem.zh: 术后第0天：入院记录显示患者主要语言为普通话，但未记录持续的术后语言服务计划。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

stem.en: Postoperative day 1: The nurse uses an English handout to teach hip precautions and rivaroxaban safety. With interpreter phone assistance, the client cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs, or missed-dose instructions. Which nursing action is best?
stem.zh: 术后第1天：护士用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和利伐沙班安全。借助电话解释服务，患者仍不能说出药名、用途、出血征象或漏服处理。哪项护理措施最佳？

stem.en: Postoperative day 1: The client is medically stable, but the discharge-readiness screen shows unsafe walker use, no confirmed home support, no home health referral, incomplete teaching, no stair assessment, and a rising creatinine while taking rivaroxaban. Which nursing actions are necessary to address the discharge barriers before the client goes home? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第1天：患者医学状况稳定，但出院准备筛查显示助行器使用不安全、无确认居家支持、未转介居家护理、教育未完成、尚未评估楼梯能力，并且服用利伐沙班期间肌酐上升。为在患者回家前处理这些出院障碍，护士需要采取哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Postoperative day 2: The client's creatinine rose from 1.4 mg/dL to 1.5 mg/dL on postoperative day 1 and improved to 1.4 mg/dL after hydration. eGFR is 39 mL/min. The client is prescribed rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily for 35 days after hip arthroplasty. For each proposed nursing action, select whether it is appropriate or inappropriate.
stem.zh: 术后第2天：患者肌酐从1.4 mg/dL在术后第1天升至1.5 mg/dL，补液后改善至1.4 mg/dL。eGFR为39 mL/min。患者医嘱为髋关节置换术后利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天。请判断每项拟采取的护理措施是适当还是不适当。

stem.en: Postoperative day 2: Interpreter-supported teach-back is successful, but the client states she cannot independently navigate the surgeon's English-language phone system. Which actions should the nurse include in the discharge plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第2天：在解释员支持下回教成功，但患者表示无法独自应对外科医生办公室的英文电话系统。护士应在出院计划中纳入哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

stem.en: Postoperative day 3: The nurse is giving a verbal SBAR handoff to the receiving home health nurse. Which information is essential to include? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 术后第3天：护士正在向接收的居家护理护士进行SBAR口头交接。哪些信息必须纳入？选择所有适用项。

options.en: The client requires Mandarin interpretation for teaching and clinical communication.
options.zh: 患者在健康教育和临床沟通中需要普通话解释服务。

options.en: The client lives alone in a second-floor walk-up after the son leaves, and home safety/stair navigation need assessment.
options.zh: 儿子离开后患者独自住在二楼无电梯公寓，需要评估居家安全和上下楼梯。

options.en: Creatinine trended up transiently and returned to baseline; ongoing renal-function awareness is needed.
options.zh: 肌酐曾短暂升高后回到基础水平；仍需关注肾功能。

options.en: Equipment, functional status, follow-up appointment, and son's role as the phone contact have been confirmed.
options.zh: 设备、功能状态、随访预约以及儿子作为电话联系人的角色均已确认。

options.en: Rivaroxaban 10 mg daily is prescribed for 35 days; adherence and bleeding signs need monitoring.
options.zh: 医嘱为利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天；需要监测依从性和出血征象。

options.en: The client preferred hot tea during hospitalization and declined the last two oxycodone doses.
options.zh: 患者住院期间偏好热茶，并拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。

correct.en: The handoff must transmit the risks that could cause transition failure: language needs, anticoagulant adherence and bleeding monitoring, renal-function context, social isolation and home layout, mobility/equipment needs, follow-up, and the designated communication contact. These data allow the home health nurse to continue the safety plan without information loss.
correct.zh: 交接必须传递可能导致转衔失败的风险：语言需求、抗凝药依从性和出血监测、肾功能背景、社会孤立和居家环境、活动/设备需求、随访以及指定沟通联系人。这些资料能让居家护理护士在不丢失信息的情况下延续安全计划。

byChoice.en: Correct. Language needs shape how all teaching, assessment, and symptom reporting must occur.
byChoice.zh: 正确。语言需求决定所有教育、评估和症状报告应如何进行。

byChoice.en: Correct. Equipment, function, follow-up, and phone-contact arrangements are all needed for continuity of the discharge plan.
byChoice.zh: 正确。设备、功能状态、随访和电话联系人安排都是延续出院计划所需的信息。

byChoice.en: Correct. Renal-function context matters because rivaroxaban has renal clearance and the client has baseline CKD.
byChoice.zh: 正确。因利伐沙班部分经肾脏清除且患者有基础CKD，肾功能背景很重要。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Declining oxycodone can support pain-control assessment, but tea preference is not essential transition-safety information; the option mixes a minor preference with a noncritical detail.
byChoice.zh: 错误。拒绝羟考酮可用于评估疼痛控制，但饮茶偏好不是关键转衔安全信息；该选项把次要偏好与非关键细节混在一起。

byChoice.en: Correct. Living alone in a walk-up apartment affects fall risk, access to care, and the home safety assessment.
byChoice.zh: 正确。独居在无电梯楼房会影响跌倒风险、获得照护能力和居家安全评估。

byChoice.en: Correct. Anticoagulant dose, duration, adherence, and bleeding surveillance are high-priority safety details.
byChoice.zh: 正确。抗凝药剂量、疗程、依从性和出血监测属于高优先级安全信息。

testTakingStrategy.en: For handoff items, choose information that changes the receiving clinician's monitoring, teaching, safety checks, or follow-up actions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 交接题应选择会改变接收方临床人员监测、教育、安全检查或随访行动的信息。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items about discharge readiness and care coordination.
查看患者病历，并回答有关出院准备情况和护理协调的病例题。
Unfolding case: discharge coordination after right total hip arthroplasty
展开病例：右全髋关节置换术后的出院协调

An 82-year-old Mandarin-speaking client is recovering from elective right total hip arthroplasty. The nurse must coordinate language access, mobility readiness, medication safety, home health services, and handoff planning before discharge home.
一名82岁、主要讲普通话的患者正在从择期右全髋关节置换术中恢复。护士必须在患者回家出院前协调语言服务、活动能力准备、用药安全、居家护理服务和交接计划。

1530: Mrs. Chen, age 82, is admitted to the orthopedic surgical unit after uncomplicated elective right total hip arthroplasty for osteoarthritis. Primary language: Mandarin. She can exchange simple greetings in English but cannot reliably discuss medications, follow multistep instructions, or read English discharge documents. She lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment. Her adult son lives 2 hours away and works full-time. She does not own a smartphone and uses a corded landline at home.

History: hypertension, mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min), and type 2 diabetes. No history of venous thromboembolism.

Orders: rivaroxaban 10 mg PO daily for 35 days for VTE prophylaxis; acetaminophen 1 g PO every 6 hr scheduled; oxycodone 5 mg PO every 4 hr PRN breakthrough pain; home amlodipine and metformin; incentive spirometry every 1-2 hr while awake; sequential compression devices while in bed; physical therapy consult on postoperative day 1; posterior hip precautions: no flexion beyond 90 degrees, no internal rotation, and no adduction past midline.

Initial findings at 1600: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 82, BP 138/78, RR 16, SpO₂ 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. Alert and oriented to person and place with interpreter phone assistance. Pain 5/10. Dressing clean, dry, intact; drain output 50 mL sanguineous since OR. Right pedal pulse 2+, capillary refill <3 sec, sensation intact, and dorsiflexion/plantarflexion present. Foley catheter draining clear yellow urine. Call light within reach and bed alarm activated. The nurse observes the client leaning across the bed rail for water, suggesting she may not understand fall-prevention instructions.

Baseline labs: Hgb 10.8 g/dL (pre-op 12.1), Hct 32%, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, WBC 9.2 ×10³/µL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec, BUN 24 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, eGFR 38 mL/min, K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L, Na⁺ 139 mEq/L, glucose 162 mg/dL, albumin 3.1 g/dL.

Chart concern: Mandarin is listed as the primary language. Informed consent was signed with an interpreter present, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented.

1530：陈女士，82岁，因骨关节炎接受择期右全髋关节置换术后入住骨科外科病区，手术过程无并发症。主要语言：普通话。她能用英语进行简单问候，但不能可靠地讨论药物、执行多步骤指令或阅读英文出院文件。她独自住在二楼无电梯公寓。成年儿子住在2小时车程外，并全职工作。她没有智能手机，家中使用有线座机。

病史：高血压、轻度慢性肾病（基础肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min）和2型糖尿病。无静脉血栓栓塞史。

医嘱：利伐沙班10 mg口服每日一次，共35天，用于VTE预防；对乙酰氨基酚1 g口服每6小时定时；羟考酮5 mg口服每4小时按需用于突破性疼痛；继续家庭剂量的氨氯地平和二甲双胍；清醒时每1–2小时使用激励肺量计；卧床时使用序贯加压装置；术后第1天物理治疗会诊；后路髋关节置换注意事项：髋屈曲不超过90度、不得内旋、不得内收越过中线。

1600初始评估：体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/78 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，SpO₂ 96%（鼻导管2 L）。借助电话解释服务评估，患者能辨认本人和地点。疼痛5/10。敷料清洁、干燥、完整；从手术室至今引流出血性液体50 mL。右足背动脉搏动2+，毛细血管再充盈<3秒，感觉完整，可背屈和跖屈。导尿管引流清亮黄色尿液。呼叫铃在可及范围内，床报警已开启。护士观察到患者越过床栏伸手拿水，提示她可能不理解防跌倒指示。

基础实验室：血红蛋白10.8 g/dL（术前12.1），血细胞比容32%，血小板198 ×10³/µL，白细胞9.2 ×10³/µL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28秒，BUN 24 mg/dL，肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 38 mL/min，K⁺ 4.0 mEq/L，Na⁺ 139 mEq/L，血糖162 mg/dL，白蛋白3.1 g/dL。

病历关注点：病历列明主要语言为普通话。知情同意书在解释员在场时签署，但未记录术后持续语言服务计划。
Postoperative day 0: admission record and initial assessment
术后第0天：入院记录和初始评估

About 18 hr after surgery: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 78, BP 132/74, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Pain 4/10 at rest and 7/10 with movement using an interpreter phone. Drain removed per order; incision approximated with staples, mild ecchymosis, no erythema, and scant serous drainage. Foley removed; client voided 250 mL. Oral medications tolerated.

Repeat labs: Hgb 10.2 g/dL, creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, eGFR 36 mL/min, glucose 148 mg/dL.

PT session: Client sits at the edge of the bed and stands with a front-wheeled walker using moderate assistance from two people. She is unsteady, attempts to lift the walker, loses balance once but is caught by PT, and cannot safely rise from a standard-height chair independently. PT documents that she is not safe for discharge home without continued walker training and a home-safety evaluation. PT recommends at least two more sessions and home PT after discharge.

Teaching attempt: The nurse attempts hip-precaution and anticoagulant teaching using an English handout. The client nods and smiles but cannot demonstrate understanding. With interpreter phone assistance, she cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs to report, or what to do if a dose is missed. The nurse documents failed teach-back and the need for a certified Mandarin interpreter for comprehensive discharge teaching.

Unresolved discharge barriers: lives alone with no confirmed support for the first 48-72 hr; unsafe walker use; discharge teaching incomplete because of language barrier; no home health referral; uncertain rivaroxaban adherence; second-floor walk-up with no stair assessment; no confirmed follow-up appointment; creatinine trending upward while receiving a renally cleared anticoagulant.

术后约18小时：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率78次/分，血压132/74 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 97%。通过电话解释服务评估，静息疼痛4/10，活动时疼痛7/10。按医嘱拔除引流管；切口以皮钉闭合，轻度瘀斑，无红斑，少量浆液性渗液。拔除导尿管；患者自行排尿250 mL。可耐受口服药物。

复查实验室：血红蛋白10.2 g/dL，肌酐1.5 mg/dL，eGFR 36 mL/min，血糖148 mg/dL。

物理治疗记录：患者可在床边坐起，并在两人中等协助下使用前轮助行器站立。她步态不稳，试图把助行器抬起，曾失去平衡一次但被物理治疗师扶住，且无法独立安全地从标准高度椅子上站起。物理治疗记录显示，在继续助行器训练和居家安全评估之前，患者尚不适合回家出院。PT建议至少再进行两次训练，并在出院后安排居家物理治疗。

健康教育尝试：护士使用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和抗凝药。患者点头微笑，但不能证明理解。借助电话解释服务，她不能说出药名、用途、需报告的出血征象或漏服后的处理。护士记录回教失败，并记录需要合格普通话医疗解释员进行全面出院教育。

未解决的出院障碍：独居且最初48–72小时无确认照护者；助行器使用不安全；因语言障碍出院教育未完成；未转介居家护理；利伐沙班依从性不确定；二楼无电梯且尚未评估上下楼梯能力；未确认随访预约；正在使用经肾脏清除的抗凝药且肌酐上升。
Morning assessment, PT note, and education attempt
晨间评估、物理治疗记录和健康教育尝试
术后第1天：出院准备筛查

About 42 hr after surgery: T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 128/72, RR 14, SpO₂ 98% on room air. Pain 3/10 at rest and 5/10 with movement. Incision clean with staples intact and no signs of infection. Repeat creatinine 1.4 mg/dL after hydration and adequate oral intake; eGFR 39 mL/min. Hgb 10.0 g/dL.

Social work/case management interviews the client using a telephone interpreter. Her son can be present on the day of discharge and the following day, but not beyond that. She receives Meals on Wheels and has Medicare with a supplemental plan. Case management determines that she qualifies for Medicare home health services because she is homebound and requires skilled nursing plus home PT. The home health referral is initiated.

PT session: Client demonstrates safe walker use on level ground with standby assistance and can perform sit-to-stand from a raised toilet seat independently. Stairs have not yet been attempted. Afternoon PT stair training is planned.

Interpreter-mediated education: A certified in-person Mandarin interpreter is present. The nurse teaches posterior hip precautions, rivaroxaban purpose and 10 mg once-daily schedule for 35 days, bleeding signs, missed-dose instructions, pain medication safety, and when to call the surgeon or seek emergency care. The client accurately repeats key points in Mandarin, demonstrates hip precautions with a model, and identifies the rivaroxaban pill. She states she would need her son to call the surgeon because she cannot navigate the English phone tree alone. The nurse flags this as a remaining barrier.

Afternoon PT: Client negotiates four stairs up and down with a walker and one handrail with standby assistance. PT clears her for discharge home with home PT, front-wheeled walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse requests a Mandarin-translated home exercise program. The surgeon writes a discharge order for postoperative day 3 morning pending nursing confirmation of discharge readiness.

术后约42小时：体温98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率74次/分，血压128/72 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 98%。静息疼痛3/10，活动时5/10。切口清洁，皮钉完整，无感染迹象。补液并充分口服摄入后复查肌酐1.4 mg/dL，eGFR 39 mL/min。血红蛋白10.0 g/dL。

社会工作/个案管理通过电话解释员访谈患者。她的儿子可在出院当天和次日陪伴，但之后不能继续陪伴。她接受送餐服务，并有Medicare及补充保险。个案管理判断，由于她居家受限且需要专业护理和居家物理治疗，符合Medicare居家护理服务条件。居家护理转介已启动。

物理治疗：患者在平地使用助行器时仅需旁站协助，可独立从加高马桶座上坐站转换。尚未尝试楼梯。计划下午进行楼梯训练。

解释员参与的健康教育：合格的现场普通话医疗解释员在场。护士讲解后路髋关节注意事项、利伐沙班用途及10 mg每日一次共35天的服药安排、出血征象、漏服处理、止痛药安全，以及何时联系外科医生或急诊就医。患者能用普通话准确复述要点，用模型示范髋关节注意事项，并能辨认利伐沙班药片。她表示若有问题需让儿子致电外科医生，因为她无法独自应对英文电话系统。护士将此标记为剩余障碍。

下午物理治疗：患者在旁站协助下使用助行器和一侧扶手上下四级台阶。PT同意其在安排居家PT、前轮助行器、加高马桶座和取物器后回家出院。护士要求康复部门提供普通话版居家运动计划。外科医生开具术后第3天上午出院医嘱，前提是护士确认出院准备充分。
Coordination update, renal trend, and teach-back session
协调进展、肾功能趋势和回教环节

About 66 hr after surgery: T 98.1 °F (36.7 °C), HR 72, BP 126/70, RR 14, SpO₂ 99% on room air. Pain 2/10 at rest and 4/10 with movement, controlled with scheduled acetaminophen alone; client declined the last two oxycodone doses. Incision clean and dry. Creatinine 1.3 mg/dL, eGFR 42 mL/min. Hgb 9.8 g/dL and stable. Glucose 132 mg/dL.

Final readiness verification: The Visiting Nurse Association accepts the referral. First home visit for skilled nursing and PT is confirmed for the day after discharge. The nurse calls the receiving home health nurse using SBAR and communicates language needs, the need for an interpreter for teaching, social situation, functional status, equipment, rivaroxaban dose/duration and adherence concerns, renal-function trend, bleeding surveillance, son's role as the communication contact, and the confirmed follow-up appointment. The home health agency confirms that a Mandarin-speaking home health aide is available.

The nurse calls the surgeon's office to confirm the 2-week follow-up appointment and requests that a Mandarin interpreter be scheduled. The son arrives at 0900. With video interpreter assistance, the nurse reviews discharge instructions with the client and son together, confirms that the son understands how to reach the surgeon's office, provides the home health agency phone number, and gives the client a 7-day pill organizer labeled in Mandarin. The client is discharged at 1030 by wheelchair to her son's car with the walker, raised toilet seat, and reacher/grabber. The nurse documents that all identified discharge barriers are resolved or have a confirmed community plan of care.

术后约66小时：体温98.1 °F (36.7 °C)，心率72次/分，血压126/70 mmHg，呼吸14次/分，室内空气SpO₂ 99%。静息疼痛2/10，活动时4/10，仅用定时对乙酰氨基酚即可控制；患者拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。切口清洁干燥。肌酐1.3 mg/dL，eGFR 42 mL/min。血红蛋白9.8 g/dL且稳定。血糖132 mg/dL。

最终出院准备核查：访问护士协会接受转介。已确认出院后次日进行首次居家专业护理和物理治疗。护士使用SBAR致电接收的居家护理护士，沟通语言需求、所有教学需使用解释员、社会情况、功能状态、设备、利伐沙班剂量/疗程及依从性关注点、肾功能趋势、出血监测、儿子作为沟通联系人，以及已确认的随访预约。居家护理机构确认可安排会普通话的居家护理助理。

护士致电外科医生办公室确认2周随访预约，并要求安排普通话解释员。儿子于0900到达。护士借助视频解释员与患者和儿子共同复习出院说明，确认儿子知道如何联系外科医生办公室，提供居家护理机构电话号码，并给患者一盒以普通话标注的7天药盒。患者于1030坐轮椅至儿子的汽车，助行器、加高马桶座和取物器一并带走。护士记录所有已识别的出院障碍均已解决，或已有确认的社区照护计划。
Postoperative day 3: final discharge verification and handoff
术后第3天：最终出院核查和交接
Postoperative day 0: The admission record lists Mandarin as the client's primary language, but no ongoing postoperative language-access plan is documented. Which action should the nurse take first?
术后第0天：入院记录显示患者主要语言为普通话，但未记录持续的术后语言服务计划。护士首先应采取哪项措施？

Postoperative day 1: The nurse uses an English handout to teach hip precautions and rivaroxaban safety. With interpreter phone assistance, the client cannot state the medication name, purpose, bleeding signs, or missed-dose instructions. Which nursing action is best?
术后第1天：护士用英文资料讲解髋关节注意事项和利伐沙班安全。借助电话解释服务，患者仍不能说出药名、用途、出血征象或漏服处理。哪项护理措施最佳？

Postoperative day 1: The client is medically stable, but the discharge-readiness screen shows unsafe walker use, no confirmed home support, no home health referral, incomplete teaching, no stair assessment, and a rising creatinine while taking rivaroxaban. Which nursing actions are necessary to address the discharge barriers before the client goes home? Select all that apply.
术后第1天：患者医学状况稳定，但出院准备筛查显示助行器使用不安全、无确认居家支持、未转介居家护理、教育未完成、尚未评估楼梯能力，并且服用利伐沙班期间肌酐上升。为在患者回家前处理这些出院障碍，护士需要采取哪些措施？选择所有适用项。

Postoperative day 2: The client's creatinine rose from 1.4 mg/dL to 1.5 mg/dL on postoperative day 1 and improved to 1.4 mg/dL after hydration. eGFR is 39 mL/min. The client is prescribed rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily for 35 days after hip arthroplasty. For each proposed nursing action, select whether it is appropriate or inappropriate.
术后第2天：患者肌酐从1.4 mg/dL在术后第1天升至1.5 mg/dL，补液后改善至1.4 mg/dL。eGFR为39 mL/min。患者医嘱为髋关节置换术后利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天。请判断每项拟采取的护理措施是适当还是不适当。

Postoperative day 2: Interpreter-supported teach-back is successful, but the client states she cannot independently navigate the surgeon's English-language phone system. Which actions should the nurse include in the discharge plan? Select all that apply.
术后第2天：在解释员支持下回教成功，但患者表示无法独自应对外科医生办公室的英文电话系统。护士应在出院计划中纳入哪些措施？选择所有适用项。
Postoperative day 3: The nurse is giving a verbal SBAR handoff to the receiving home health nurse. Which information is essential to include? Select all that apply.
术后第3天：护士正在向接收的居家护理护士进行SBAR口头交接。哪些信息必须纳入？选择所有适用项。
The client requires Mandarin interpretation for teaching and clinical communication.
患者在健康教育和临床沟通中需要普通话解释服务。
The client lives alone in a second-floor walk-up after the son leaves, and home safety/stair navigation need assessment.
儿子离开后患者独自住在二楼无电梯公寓，需要评估居家安全和上下楼梯。
Creatinine trended up transiently and returned to baseline; ongoing renal-function awareness is needed.
肌酐曾短暂升高后回到基础水平；仍需关注肾功能。
Equipment, functional status, follow-up appointment, and son's role as the phone contact have been confirmed.
设备、功能状态、随访预约以及儿子作为电话联系人的角色均已确认。
Rivaroxaban 10 mg daily is prescribed for 35 days; adherence and bleeding signs need monitoring.
医嘱为利伐沙班10 mg每日一次，共35天；需要监测依从性和出血征象。
The client preferred hot tea during hospitalization and declined the last two oxycodone doses.
患者住院期间偏好热茶，并拒绝了最近两次羟考酮。
Correct. Language needs shape how all teaching, assessment, and symptom reporting must occur.
正确。语言需求决定所有教育、评估和症状报告应如何进行。
Correct. Equipment, function, follow-up, and phone-contact arrangements are all needed for continuity of the discharge plan.
正确。设备、功能状态、随访和电话联系人安排都是延续出院计划所需的信息。
Correct. Renal-function context matters because rivaroxaban has renal clearance and the client has baseline CKD.
正确。因利伐沙班部分经肾脏清除且患者有基础CKD，肾功能背景很重要。
Incorrect. Declining oxycodone can support pain-control assessment, but tea preference is not essential transition-safety information; the option mixes a minor preference with a noncritical detail.
错误。拒绝羟考酮可用于评估疼痛控制，但饮茶偏好不是关键转衔安全信息；该选项把次要偏好与非关键细节混在一起。
Correct. Living alone in a walk-up apartment affects fall risk, access to care, and the home safety assessment.
正确。独居在无电梯楼房会影响跌倒风险、获得照护能力和居家安全评估。
Correct. Anticoagulant dose, duration, adherence, and bleeding surveillance are high-priority safety details.
正确。抗凝药剂量、疗程、依从性和出血监测属于高优先级安全信息。

The handoff must transmit the risks that could cause transition failure: language needs, anticoagulant adherence and bleeding monitoring, renal-function context, social isolation and home layout, mobility/equipment needs, follow-up, and the designated communication contact. These data allow the home health nurse to continue the safety plan without information loss.
交接必须传递可能导致转衔失败的风险：语言需求、抗凝药依从性和出血监测、肾功能背景、社会孤立和居家环境、活动/设备需求、随访以及指定沟通联系人。这些资料能让居家护理护士在不丢失信息的情况下延续安全计划。
For handoff items, choose information that changes the receiving clinician's monitoring, teaching, safety checks, or follow-up actions.
交接题应选择会改变接收方临床人员监测、教育、安全检查或随访行动的信息。

stem.zh: 查阅患者病历并回答病例研究问题。

title.en: Warfarin initiation with enoxaparin bridge therapy at discharge following acute deep vein thrombosis.
title.zh: 急性深静脉血栓形成后出院时依诺肝素桥接治疗联合华法林初始治疗。

summary.en: A 63-year-old man is being prepared for discharge from a medical-surgical unit after a five-day hospitalization for an acute left lower-extremity proximal deep vein thrombosis (DVT) extending from the popliteal to the common femoral vein, confirmed by duplex ultrasonography on admission day. His medical history includes obesity (BMI 34), type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with amlodipine 10 mg daily, and osteoarthritis for which he has been taking over-the-counter ibuprofen 400 mg as needed, typically three to four times per week. He has no history of prior venous thromboembolism, no known bleeding disorders, and no prior exposure to anticoagulants. He lives with his wife, manages his own medications, and works as a long-haul truck driver. He was started on a therapeutic enoxaparin dose of 1 mg/kg subcutaneously every 12 hours on admission day, and warfarin 5 mg daily was initiated on the evening of hospital day 2. His renal function is normal (eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73 m²). The facility's specific discharge protocol calls for continuing the enoxaparin bridge at home until the INR is therapeutic (2.0–3.0) on two consecutive measurements at least 24 hours apart, which is stricter than the standard minimum of five days of overlap with an INR ≥2.0 for at least 24 hours.
summary.zh: 一名63岁男性患者在内外科病房住院5天后准备出院。他因左下肢近端急性深静脉血栓形成（DVT）（从腘静脉延伸至股总静脉）入院，入院当天通过多普勒超声确认。他的病史包括肥胖（BMI 34）、服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次控制的2型糖尿病、服用氨氯地平10 mg，每日一次控制的高血压，以及骨关节炎，为此他按需服用非处方布洛芬400 mg，通常每周3至4次。他没有既往静脉血栓栓塞史，没有已知的出血性疾病，既往未曾使用过抗凝剂。他与妻子同住，自己管理药物，是一名长途卡车司机。入院当天他开始接受治疗剂量的依诺肝素，1 mg/kg，皮下注射，每12小时一次，并在住院第2天晚上开始每天服用华法林5 mg。他的肾功能正常（eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73 m²）。该机构的具体出院方案要求在家中继续依诺肝素桥接治疗，直到至少相隔24小时的连续两次测量中INR达到治疗范围（2.0-3.0），这比依诺肝素和华法林至少重叠五天且INR≥2.0至少24小时的标准下限更为严格。

title.zh: 评估与实验室检查（基线 - 住院第5天上午）

content.en:
ASSESSMENT FINDINGS:
T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 134/78, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Alert, oriented, in no acute distress. Left lower extremity: mild residual edema from mid-calf to ankle, no erythema or warmth, pedal pulse palpable, sensation intact, compression stocking in place. No bruising at enoxaparin injection sites (bilateral abdomen). No petechiae, no gum bleeding, no melena reported. Ambulating independently with mild discomfort in the left calf.

LABORATORY DATA:
Hospital day 2 (warfarin start): INR 1.0, aPTT 29 sec, platelets 212 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.8 g/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL.
Hospital day 4: INR 1.6, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.5 g/dL.
Hospital day 5 (morning of planned discharge): INR 1.9, platelets 195 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.3 g/dL.
content.zh:
评估发现：
体温 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率 74 次/分，血压 134/78 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，室内空气下 SpO₂ 97%。神志清醒，定向力正常，无急性痛苦面容。左下肢：小腿中段至脚踝有轻度残余水肿，无红斑或发热，足背动脉搏动可触及，感觉完整，已穿戴弹力袜。依诺肝素注射部位（双侧腹部）无瘀伤。无瘀点，无牙龈出血，未报告黑便。能独立行走，左小腿轻度不适。

实验室数据：
住院第2天（开始服用华法林）：INR 1.0，aPTT 29 秒，血小板 212 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.8 g/dL，肌酐 1.0 mg/dL。
住院第4天：INR 1.6，血小板 198 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.5 g/dL。
住院第5天（计划出院当天上午）：INR 1.9，血小板 195 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.3 g/dL。

content.en: The INR result of 1.9 returns while the nurse is reviewing the discharge medication list with the patient and his wife. The patient's wife asks, "The doctor said his blood needs to be between 2 and 3. It's 1.9 — is that close enough to stop the shots?" The patient adds that he took two ibuprofen tablets this morning for knee pain and asks whether he can keep taking ibuprofen at home since "it's just over the counter." The discharge medication reconciliation list generated by pharmacy includes warfarin 5 mg daily, enoxaparin 1 mg/kg every 12 hours, metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, amlodipine 10 mg daily, and ibuprofen 400 mg as needed. The patient also mentions that his wife has been reading online and bought a large bag of frozen spinach and kale to "build his blood back up" because she heard he might be anemic from the blood thinner.
content.zh: 当护士正与患者及其妻子核对出院药物清单时，回报了INR结果为1.9。患者妻子问：“医生说他的血需要在2到3之间。现在是1.9——这够接近以停止打针了吗？”患者补充说，他今天早上因为膝盖疼痛吃了两片布洛芬，并问回家后是否可以继续服用布洛芬，因为“这只是非处方药”。药房生成的出院药物核对表包括每天5 mg华法林、每12小时1 mg/kg依诺肝素、每天两次1,000 mg二甲双胍、每天10 mg氨氯地平，以及按需400 mg布洛芬。患者还提到，他妻子在网上查过资料，买了一大袋冷冻菠菜和羽衣甘蓝来“给他补血”，因为她听说他可能会因为服用血液稀释剂而贫血。

content.en: The nurse has notified the provider about the ibuprofen on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's reported use this morning. The provider discontinues ibuprofen and writes for acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, maximum 3 grams per day given the patient's age. The provider confirms that the INR of 1.9 does not meet the therapeutic threshold and that the enoxaparin bridge must continue at home; warfarin will continue at 5 mg daily, and the first outpatient INR is ordered for two days post-discharge at the anticoagulation clinic. During the teaching session, the patient asks how to give himself the enoxaparin injections at home — he has watched the nurses do it but has never self-administered. His wife volunteers to give the injections. The nurse begins a return demonstration. During the demonstration, the wife pinches a skin fold on the patient's abdomen and prepares to aspirate before injecting. The patient asks, "How will I know if something is going wrong with the blood thinner — like if I'm bleeding inside?"
content.zh: 护士已向医生报告了药物核对清单上的布洛芬以及患者今早报告的服用情况。医生停用了布洛芬，并开出对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg 每 6 小时按需止痛，考虑到患者的年龄，每天最多 3 克。医生确认 INR 为 1.9 未达到治疗阈值，必须在家中继续依诺肝素桥接治疗；华法林将继续每天 5 mg，首次门诊 INR 检查安排在出院后两天在抗凝诊所进行。在教学环节中，患者询问如何在家中自己注射依诺肝素——他看过护士注射，但从未自己操作过。他的妻子自告奋勇进行注射。护士开始进行回示教。在示教过程中，妻子捏起患者腹部的一块皮肤皱褶，并准备在注射前回抽。患者问：“如果血液稀释剂出了问题——比如我在内出血，我怎么会知道？”

content.en: The patient has successfully demonstrated subcutaneous injection technique with his wife. The nurse is completing the final discharge review. The patient mentions that he is scheduled to return to work driving his truck in four days and asks whether that is safe. He also asks whether he should "eat a lot of green vegetables to stay healthy" or avoid them. His wife pulls out a printed list of "foods to avoid on warfarin" she found online, which includes all leafy greens, broccoli, green tea, avocado, and soy products, and says, "I guess we just cut all of these out." The patient's final set of vitals before discharge: T 98.6 °F (37.0 °C), HR 72, BP 130/76, RR 14, SpO₂ 98%. No new bruising. Left leg edema unchanged. The anticoagulation clinic appointment is confirmed for two days post-discharge, and the patient has a printed appointment card. The nurse reviews the signs and symptoms requiring emergency care versus same-day anticoagulation clinic contact.
content.zh: 患者已成功与妻子进行了皮下注射技术的回示教。护士正在完成最后的出院检查。患者提到他计划在四天后重返工作岗位驾驶卡车，并询问这是否安全。他还问是否应该“吃很多绿色蔬菜来保持健康”还是避免吃。他的妻子拿出一份从网上打印的“服用华法林应避免的食物”清单，其中包括所有绿叶蔬菜、西兰花、绿茶、牛油果和豆制品，并说：“我想我们只能把这些都戒了。”患者出院前的最后一次生命体征：体温 98.6 °F (37.0 °C)，心率 72 次/分，血压 130/76 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，SpO₂ 98%。无新的瘀伤。左腿水肿无变化。抗凝诊所的预约确认在出院后两天，患者有一张打印的预约卡。护士复习了需要紧急救护与当天联系抗凝诊所的体征和症状。

stem.en: After reviewing the INR result with the patient and his wife at Stage 1, which of the following is the most appropriate response by the nurse regarding the enoxaparin bridge?
stem.zh: 在阶段 1 与患者及其妻子回顾 INR 结果后，关于依诺肝素桥接治疗，护士最恰当的回答是下列哪一项？

stem.en: Based on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's statements at Stage 1, what is the nurse's priority action regarding the patient's ibuprofen use?
stem.zh: 根据阶段 1 的药物核对清单和患者的陈述，关于患者使用布洛芬，护士的首要行动是什么？

stem.en: During the return demonstration at Stage 2, the nurse observes the wife preparing to aspirate before injecting the enoxaparin. What is the appropriate nursing action?
stem.zh: 在阶段 2 的回示教过程中，护士观察到妻子在注射依诺肝素前准备回抽。护士应采取的恰当行动是什么？

stem.en: At Stage 3, how should the nurse address the dietary plans regarding vitamin K and green vegetables?
stem.zh: 在阶段 3，护士应如何处理关于维生素 K 和绿色蔬菜的饮食计划？

options.en: Advise the patient to only eat green vegetables on the days his INR falls below the target range.
options.zh: 建议患者只在 INR 降至目标范围以下的那些天吃绿色蔬菜。

options.en: Encourage the daily consumption of spinach and kale to prevent anemia associated with blood thinners.
options.zh: 鼓励每天食用菠菜和羽衣甘蓝，以预防与血液稀释剂相关的贫血。

options.en: Clarify that the goal is to maintain a consistent daily intake of vitamin K, rather than completely avoiding or abruptly increasing these foods.
options.zh: 澄清目标是保持每天摄入一致的维生素 K，而不是完全避免或突然增加这些食物。

options.en: Agree with the wife's plan to eliminate all leafy greens to prevent the warfarin from becoming ineffective.
options.zh: 同意妻子停止食用所有绿叶蔬菜的计划，以防止华法林失效。

correct.en: Warfarin inhibits vitamin K–dependent clotting factors. Abrupt elimination causes INR to rise unpredictably (bleeding risk), while large increases in intake decrease INR (clot risk). Consistency is the evidence-based guidance. Furthermore, warfarin does not cause anemia through nutrient depletion.
correct.zh: 华法林抑制依赖维生素K的凝血因子。突然消除会导致 INR 不可预测地上升（出血风险），而大量增加摄入会降低 INR（血栓风险）。保持一致性是基于证据的指导方针。此外，华法林不会通过消耗营养素而导致贫血。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Eliminating vitamin K foods creates INR instability, nutritional deficiency, and is a common dietary misconception.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。消除含维生素 K 的食物会造成 INR 不稳定、营养缺乏，并且是常见的饮食误区。

byChoice.en: Correct. Consistency allows the warfarin dose to be safely calibrated to the patient's usual diet.
byChoice.zh: 正确。保持一致可以安全地根据患者的日常饮食来调整华法林剂量。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Patients should not self-manage their INR through erratic dietary changes. Diet should remain consistent.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。患者不应通过不稳定地改变饮食来管理自己的 INR。饮食应保持一致。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. A large dietary increase antagonizes warfarin, lowering the INR and potentially allowing clot extension. Warfarin does not cause nutritional anemia.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。饮食中大量增加（维生素K）会拮抗华法林，降低 INR，可能导致血栓蔓延。华法林不会引起营养性贫血。

testTakingStrategy.en: For warfarin dietary questions, 'consistency' is almost always the correct answer over 'avoidance' or 'increase'.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于华法林饮食的问题，“一致”几乎总是正确答案，而不是“避免”或“增加”。

stem.en: The nurse educates the patient at Stage 2 on recognizing bleeding signs. Categorize each sign based on whether the patient should seek immediate emergency care (call 911) or contact the anticoagulation clinic the same day.
stem.zh: 护士在阶段 2 对患者进行了识别出血体征的教育。请根据患者应寻求紧急医疗救护（拨打911）还是当天联系抗凝诊所对每个体征进行分类。

rows.zh: 突然剧烈头痛伴意识模糊
与外伤不成比例的新发瘀伤

rows.en: A small nosebleed that stops after 10 minutes of firm pressure but recurs later the same day
rows.zh: 施加重压10分钟后停止，但在同一天晚些时候复发的小量鼻出血

correct.en: Patients on dual anticoagulation must categorize bleeding by urgency. Sudden headache/confusion suggests intracranial hemorrhage (emergent). Coffee-ground emesis indicates active gastrointestinal bleeding (emergent). New excessive bruising and recurrent superficial bleeding that responds to pressure require prompt evaluation and possible dosage adjustment but are generally managed via the clinic unless bleeding is massive or uncontrolled.
correct.zh: 接受双重抗凝治疗的患者必须按紧急程度对出血体征进行分类。突然头痛/意识模糊提示颅内出血（紧急）。呕吐咖啡渣样物表明活动性胃肠道出血（紧急）。新的明显瘀伤以及经按压可止住但复发的浅表出血，需要及时评估并可能调整剂量；除非出血量大或无法控制，通常可通过诊所处理。

byChoice.en: Intracranial bleeding is a life-threatening emergency requiring 911.
byChoice.zh: 颅内出血是危及生命的紧急情况，需要拨打911。

byChoice.en: Active upper GI bleeding can lead to rapid hemodynamic instability and requires immediate emergency care.
byChoice.zh: 活动性上消化道出血可导致血流动力学迅速不稳定，需要立即进行紧急救护。

byChoice.en: Bruising requires evaluation for supratherapeutic INR but is not a 911 emergency unless rapidly expanding or compromising circulation.
byChoice.zh: 瘀伤需要评估是否有超治疗水平的 INR，但除非迅速扩大或损害循环，否则不是 911 紧急情况。

byChoice.en: A recurring nosebleed that responds to pressure requires medical attention same-day to manage hemostasis and check INR, but calling the clinic is the appropriate first step. Bleeding that will not stop with pressure is an emergency.
byChoice.zh: 对按压有反应的复发性鼻出血需要当天就医以控制出血并检查 INR，但第一步应该是联系诊所。按压后仍无法停止的出血属于紧急情况。

testTakingStrategy.en: Differentiate between signs of internal organ bleeding (brain, GI tract), which are life-threatening emergencies, and superficial bleeding (skin, mucosa), which require prompt clinic follow-up.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分内脏出血（大脑、胃肠道）的体征（这是危及生命的紧急情况）和浅表出血（皮肤、粘膜）（需要及时到诊所随访）。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the patient asks about returning to work as a long-haul truck driver in four days. What is the most appropriate response by the nurse?
stem.zh: 在阶段 3，患者询问关于四天后重返长途卡车司机工作岗位的事情。护士最恰当的回应是什么？

options.en: Suggest that the patient discuss this with his employer, as return-to-work clearance is an administrative matter.
options.zh: 建议患者与他的雇主讨论此事，因为重返工作岗位的许可是行政事务。

options.en: Inform the patient that he can return to work as long as he stops every two hours to stretch his legs.
options.zh: 告知患者他可以重返工作，只要他每两小时停下来伸展一下腿即可。

options.en: Advise the patient not to return to driving until cleared by the provider, and document this occupational concern for follow-up.
options.zh: 建议患者在获得医生许可前不要恢复驾驶，并记录这一职业安全顾虑以便随访。

options.en: Tell the patient that driving is safe since he will be on dual anticoagulation to prevent any further clots.
options.zh: 告诉患者驾驶是安全的，因为他将接受双重抗凝治疗以防止产生更多血栓。

correct.en: The patient is on dual anticoagulation with a subtherapeutic INR. Long-haul truck driving involves prolonged immobility (a DVT risk factor), limited access to emergency care, and potential impairment from bleeding events. This poses a significant safety risk that requires provider evaluation before clearance.
correct.zh: 患者正接受双重抗凝治疗，且 INR 低于治疗水平。长途卡车驾驶涉及长时间不动（DVT的危险因素）、难以获得急救医疗服务以及出血事件可能造成的损害。这构成了重大的安全风险，需要医生在批准前进行评估。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. While stretching prevents DVT, the patient is actively being titrated on anticoagulants for an acute DVT. Driving a commercial vehicle is unsafe until medically cleared.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。虽然伸展可以预防 DVT，但患者目前正因急性 DVT 而在调整抗凝剂剂量。在获得医疗许可之前驾驶商用车辆是不安全的。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The dual therapy increases bleeding risk in the event of an accident or emergency, and his INR is not yet stable.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。在发生事故或紧急情况时，双重治疗会增加出血风险，而且他的 INR 尚未稳定。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Return-to-work following an acute cardiovascular event with high-risk medication initiation is a clinical safety issue, not just administrative.
byChoice.zh: 不正确。在发生急性心血管事件并开始使用高危药物后重返工作岗位是一个临床安全问题，而不仅仅是行政问题。

byChoice.en: Correct. Identifying occupational immobility and bleeding risk as a discharge safety concern is within the nursing scope of advocacy and care coordination.
byChoice.zh: 正确。将职业性制动和出血风险识别为出院安全顾虑属于护士的倡导和护理协调范畴。

testTakingStrategy.en: Recognize that 'prolonged immobility' is a primary risk factor for DVT. Discharging an acute DVT patient back into a high-risk environment without medical clearance is unsafe.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 认识到“长时间不动”是 DVT 的主要危险因素。在没有医疗许可的情况下让急性 DVT 患者出院回到高风险环境是不安全的。

evidenceCatalog.text: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
查阅患者病历并回答病例研究问题。
Warfarin initiation with enoxaparin bridge therapy at discharge following acute deep vein thrombosis.
急性深静脉血栓形成后出院时依诺肝素桥接治疗联合华法林初始治疗。

A 63-year-old man is being prepared for discharge from a medical-surgical unit after a five-day hospitalization for an acute left lower-extremity proximal deep vein thrombosis (DVT) extending from the popliteal to the common femoral vein, confirmed by duplex ultrasonography on admission day. His medical history includes obesity (BMI 34), type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with amlodipine 10 mg daily, and osteoarthritis for which he has been taking over-the-counter ibuprofen 400 mg as needed, typically three to four times per week. He has no history of prior venous thromboembolism, no known bleeding disorders, and no prior exposure to anticoagulants. He lives with his wife, manages his own medications, and works as a long-haul truck driver. He was started on a therapeutic enoxaparin dose of 1 mg/kg subcutaneously every 12 hours on admission day, and warfarin 5 mg daily was initiated on the evening of hospital day 2. His renal function is normal (eGFR 88 mL/min/1.73 m²). The facility's specific discharge protocol calls for continuing the enoxaparin bridge at home until the INR is therapeutic (2.0–3.0) on two consecutive measurements at least 24 hours apart, which is stricter than the standard minimum of five days of overlap with an INR ≥2.0 for at least 24 hours.

ASSESSMENT FINDINGS:
T 98.4 °F (36.9 °C), HR 74, BP 134/78, RR 14, SpO₂ 97% on room air. Alert, oriented, in no acute distress. Left lower extremity: mild residual edema from mid-calf to ankle, no erythema or warmth, pedal pulse palpable, sensation intact, compression stocking in place. No bruising at enoxaparin injection sites (bilateral abdomen). No petechiae, no gum bleeding, no melena reported. Ambulating independently with mild discomfort in the left calf.

LABORATORY DATA:
Hospital day 2 (warfarin start): INR 1.0, aPTT 29 sec, platelets 212 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.8 g/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL.
Hospital day 4: INR 1.6, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.5 g/dL.
Hospital day 5 (morning of planned discharge): INR 1.9, platelets 195 ×10³/µL, Hgb 14.3 g/dL.

评估发现：
体温 98.4 °F (36.9 °C)，心率 74 次/分，血压 134/78 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，室内空气下 SpO₂ 97%。神志清醒，定向力正常，无急性痛苦面容。左下肢：小腿中段至脚踝有轻度残余水肿，无红斑或发热，足背动脉搏动可触及，感觉完整，已穿戴弹力袜。依诺肝素注射部位（双侧腹部）无瘀伤。无瘀点，无牙龈出血，未报告黑便。能独立行走，左小腿轻度不适。

实验室数据：
住院第2天（开始服用华法林）：INR 1.0，aPTT 29 秒，血小板 212 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.8 g/dL，肌酐 1.0 mg/dL。
住院第4天：INR 1.6，血小板 198 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.5 g/dL。
住院第5天（计划出院当天上午）：INR 1.9，血小板 195 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白 14.3 g/dL。
评估与实验室检查（基线 - 住院第5天上午）

The INR result of 1.9 returns while the nurse is reviewing the discharge medication list with the patient and his wife. The patient's wife asks, "The doctor said his blood needs to be between 2 and 3. It's 1.9 — is that close enough to stop the shots?" The patient adds that he took two ibuprofen tablets this morning for knee pain and asks whether he can keep taking ibuprofen at home since "it's just over the counter." The discharge medication reconciliation list generated by pharmacy includes warfarin 5 mg daily, enoxaparin 1 mg/kg every 12 hours, metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, amlodipine 10 mg daily, and ibuprofen 400 mg as needed. The patient also mentions that his wife has been reading online and bought a large bag of frozen spinach and kale to "build his blood back up" because she heard he might be anemic from the blood thinner.

当护士正与患者及其妻子核对出院药物清单时，回报了INR结果为1.9。患者妻子问：“医生说他的血需要在2到3之间。现在是1.9——这够接近以停止打针了吗？”患者补充说，他今天早上因为膝盖疼痛吃了两片布洛芬，并问回家后是否可以继续服用布洛芬，因为“这只是非处方药”。药房生成的出院药物核对表包括每天5 mg华法林、每12小时1 mg/kg依诺肝素、每天两次1,000 mg二甲双胍、每天10 mg氨氯地平，以及按需400 mg布洛芬。患者还提到，他妻子在网上查过资料，买了一大袋冷冻菠菜和羽衣甘蓝来“给他补血”，因为她听说他可能会因为服用血液稀释剂而贫血。

The nurse has notified the provider about the ibuprofen on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's reported use this morning. The provider discontinues ibuprofen and writes for acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain, maximum 3 grams per day given the patient's age. The provider confirms that the INR of 1.9 does not meet the therapeutic threshold and that the enoxaparin bridge must continue at home; warfarin will continue at 5 mg daily, and the first outpatient INR is ordered for two days post-discharge at the anticoagulation clinic. During the teaching session, the patient asks how to give himself the enoxaparin injections at home — he has watched the nurses do it but has never self-administered. His wife volunteers to give the injections. The nurse begins a return demonstration. During the demonstration, the wife pinches a skin fold on the patient's abdomen and prepares to aspirate before injecting. The patient asks, "How will I know if something is going wrong with the blood thinner — like if I'm bleeding inside?"

护士已向医生报告了药物核对清单上的布洛芬以及患者今早报告的服用情况。医生停用了布洛芬，并开出对乙酰氨基酚 650 mg 每 6 小时按需止痛，考虑到患者的年龄，每天最多 3 克。医生确认 INR 为 1.9 未达到治疗阈值，必须在家中继续依诺肝素桥接治疗；华法林将继续每天 5 mg，首次门诊 INR 检查安排在出院后两天在抗凝诊所进行。在教学环节中，患者询问如何在家中自己注射依诺肝素——他看过护士注射，但从未自己操作过。他的妻子自告奋勇进行注射。护士开始进行回示教。在示教过程中，妻子捏起患者腹部的一块皮肤皱褶，并准备在注射前回抽。患者问：“如果血液稀释剂出了问题——比如我在内出血，我怎么会知道？”

The patient has successfully demonstrated subcutaneous injection technique with his wife. The nurse is completing the final discharge review. The patient mentions that he is scheduled to return to work driving his truck in four days and asks whether that is safe. He also asks whether he should "eat a lot of green vegetables to stay healthy" or avoid them. His wife pulls out a printed list of "foods to avoid on warfarin" she found online, which includes all leafy greens, broccoli, green tea, avocado, and soy products, and says, "I guess we just cut all of these out." The patient's final set of vitals before discharge: T 98.6 °F (37.0 °C), HR 72, BP 130/76, RR 14, SpO₂ 98%. No new bruising. Left leg edema unchanged. The anticoagulation clinic appointment is confirmed for two days post-discharge, and the patient has a printed appointment card. The nurse reviews the signs and symptoms requiring emergency care versus same-day anticoagulation clinic contact.

患者已成功与妻子进行了皮下注射技术的回示教。护士正在完成最后的出院检查。患者提到他计划在四天后重返工作岗位驾驶卡车，并询问这是否安全。他还问是否应该“吃很多绿色蔬菜来保持健康”还是避免吃。他的妻子拿出一份从网上打印的“服用华法林应避免的食物”清单，其中包括所有绿叶蔬菜、西兰花、绿茶、牛油果和豆制品，并说：“我想我们只能把这些都戒了。”患者出院前的最后一次生命体征：体温 98.6 °F (37.0 °C)，心率 72 次/分，血压 130/76 mmHg，呼吸 14 次/分，SpO₂ 98%。无新的瘀伤。左腿水肿无变化。抗凝诊所的预约确认在出院后两天，患者有一张打印的预约卡。护士复习了需要紧急救护与当天联系抗凝诊所的体征和症状。
After reviewing the INR result with the patient and his wife at Stage 1, which of the following is the most appropriate response by the nurse regarding the enoxaparin bridge?
在阶段 1 与患者及其妻子回顾 INR 结果后，关于依诺肝素桥接治疗，护士最恰当的回答是下列哪一项？
Based on the medication reconciliation list and the patient's statements at Stage 1, what is the nurse's priority action regarding the patient's ibuprofen use?
根据阶段 1 的药物核对清单和患者的陈述，关于患者使用布洛芬，护士的首要行动是什么？
During the return demonstration at Stage 2, the nurse observes the wife preparing to aspirate before injecting the enoxaparin. What is the appropriate nursing action?
在阶段 2 的回示教过程中，护士观察到妻子在注射依诺肝素前准备回抽。护士应采取的恰当行动是什么？

The nurse educates the patient at Stage 2 on recognizing bleeding signs. Categorize each sign based on whether the patient should seek immediate emergency care (call 911) or contact the anticoagulation clinic the same day.
护士在阶段 2 对患者进行了识别出血体征的教育。请根据患者应寻求紧急医疗救护（拨打911）还是当天联系抗凝诊所对每个体征进行分类。
突然剧烈头痛伴意识模糊
与外伤不成比例的新发瘀伤
A small nosebleed that stops after 10 minutes of firm pressure but recurs later the same day
施加重压10分钟后停止，但在同一天晚些时候复发的小量鼻出血
Intracranial bleeding is a life-threatening emergency requiring 911.
颅内出血是危及生命的紧急情况，需要拨打911。
Active upper GI bleeding can lead to rapid hemodynamic instability and requires immediate emergency care.
活动性上消化道出血可导致血流动力学迅速不稳定，需要立即进行紧急救护。
Bruising requires evaluation for supratherapeutic INR but is not a 911 emergency unless rapidly expanding or compromising circulation.
瘀伤需要评估是否有超治疗水平的 INR，但除非迅速扩大或损害循环，否则不是 911 紧急情况。

A recurring nosebleed that responds to pressure requires medical attention same-day to manage hemostasis and check INR, but calling the clinic is the appropriate first step. Bleeding that will not stop with pressure is an emergency.
对按压有反应的复发性鼻出血需要当天就医以控制出血并检查 INR，但第一步应该是联系诊所。按压后仍无法停止的出血属于紧急情况。

Patients on dual anticoagulation must categorize bleeding by urgency. Sudden headache/confusion suggests intracranial hemorrhage (emergent). Coffee-ground emesis indicates active gastrointestinal bleeding (emergent). New excessive bruising and recurrent superficial bleeding that responds to pressure require prompt evaluation and possible dosage adjustment but are generally managed via the clinic unless bleeding is massive or uncontrolled.
接受双重抗凝治疗的患者必须按紧急程度对出血体征进行分类。突然头痛/意识模糊提示颅内出血（紧急）。呕吐咖啡渣样物表明活动性胃肠道出血（紧急）。新的明显瘀伤以及经按压可止住但复发的浅表出血，需要及时评估并可能调整剂量；除非出血量大或无法控制，通常可通过诊所处理。
Differentiate between signs of internal organ bleeding (brain, GI tract), which are life-threatening emergencies, and superficial bleeding (skin, mucosa), which require prompt clinic follow-up.
区分内脏出血（大脑、胃肠道）的体征（这是危及生命的紧急情况）和浅表出血（皮肤、粘膜）（需要及时到诊所随访）。
At Stage 3, how should the nurse address the dietary plans regarding vitamin K and green vegetables?
在阶段 3，护士应如何处理关于维生素 K 和绿色蔬菜的饮食计划？
Advise the patient to only eat green vegetables on the days his INR falls below the target range.
建议患者只在 INR 降至目标范围以下的那些天吃绿色蔬菜。
Encourage the daily consumption of spinach and kale to prevent anemia associated with blood thinners.
鼓励每天食用菠菜和羽衣甘蓝，以预防与血液稀释剂相关的贫血。
Clarify that the goal is to maintain a consistent daily intake of vitamin K, rather than completely avoiding or abruptly increasing these foods.
澄清目标是保持每天摄入一致的维生素 K，而不是完全避免或突然增加这些食物。
Agree with the wife's plan to eliminate all leafy greens to prevent the warfarin from becoming ineffective.
同意妻子停止食用所有绿叶蔬菜的计划，以防止华法林失效。
Incorrect. Eliminating vitamin K foods creates INR instability, nutritional deficiency, and is a common dietary misconception.
不正确。消除含维生素 K 的食物会造成 INR 不稳定、营养缺乏，并且是常见的饮食误区。
Correct. Consistency allows the warfarin dose to be safely calibrated to the patient's usual diet.
正确。保持一致可以安全地根据患者的日常饮食来调整华法林剂量。
Incorrect. Patients should not self-manage their INR through erratic dietary changes. Diet should remain consistent.
不正确。患者不应通过不稳定地改变饮食来管理自己的 INR。饮食应保持一致。
Incorrect. A large dietary increase antagonizes warfarin, lowering the INR and potentially allowing clot extension. Warfarin does not cause nutritional anemia.
不正确。饮食中大量增加（维生素K）会拮抗华法林，降低 INR，可能导致血栓蔓延。华法林不会引起营养性贫血。

Warfarin inhibits vitamin K–dependent clotting factors. Abrupt elimination causes INR to rise unpredictably (bleeding risk), while large increases in intake decrease INR (clot risk). Consistency is the evidence-based guidance. Furthermore, warfarin does not cause anemia through nutrient depletion.
华法林抑制依赖维生素K的凝血因子。突然消除会导致 INR 不可预测地上升（出血风险），而大量增加摄入会降低 INR（血栓风险）。保持一致性是基于证据的指导方针。此外，华法林不会通过消耗营养素而导致贫血。
For warfarin dietary questions, 'consistency' is almost always the correct answer over 'avoidance' or 'increase'.
对于华法林饮食的问题，“一致”几乎总是正确答案，而不是“避免”或“增加”。
At Stage 3, the patient asks about returning to work as a long-haul truck driver in four days. What is the most appropriate response by the nurse?
在阶段 3，患者询问关于四天后重返长途卡车司机工作岗位的事情。护士最恰当的回应是什么？
Suggest that the patient discuss this with his employer, as return-to-work clearance is an administrative matter.
建议患者与他的雇主讨论此事，因为重返工作岗位的许可是行政事务。
Inform the patient that he can return to work as long as he stops every two hours to stretch his legs.
告知患者他可以重返工作，只要他每两小时停下来伸展一下腿即可。
Advise the patient not to return to driving until cleared by the provider, and document this occupational concern for follow-up.
建议患者在获得医生许可前不要恢复驾驶，并记录这一职业安全顾虑以便随访。
Tell the patient that driving is safe since he will be on dual anticoagulation to prevent any further clots.
告诉患者驾驶是安全的，因为他将接受双重抗凝治疗以防止产生更多血栓。
Incorrect. While stretching prevents DVT, the patient is actively being titrated on anticoagulants for an acute DVT. Driving a commercial vehicle is unsafe until medically cleared.
不正确。虽然伸展可以预防 DVT，但患者目前正因急性 DVT 而在调整抗凝剂剂量。在获得医疗许可之前驾驶商用车辆是不安全的。
Incorrect. The dual therapy increases bleeding risk in the event of an accident or emergency, and his INR is not yet stable.
不正确。在发生事故或紧急情况时，双重治疗会增加出血风险，而且他的 INR 尚未稳定。
Incorrect. Return-to-work following an acute cardiovascular event with high-risk medication initiation is a clinical safety issue, not just administrative.
不正确。在发生急性心血管事件并开始使用高危药物后重返工作岗位是一个临床安全问题，而不仅仅是行政问题。
Correct. Identifying occupational immobility and bleeding risk as a discharge safety concern is within the nursing scope of advocacy and care coordination.
正确。将职业性制动和出血风险识别为出院安全顾虑属于护士的倡导和护理协调范畴。

The patient is on dual anticoagulation with a subtherapeutic INR. Long-haul truck driving involves prolonged immobility (a DVT risk factor), limited access to emergency care, and potential impairment from bleeding events. This poses a significant safety risk that requires provider evaluation before clearance.
患者正接受双重抗凝治疗，且 INR 低于治疗水平。长途卡车驾驶涉及长时间不动（DVT的危险因素）、难以获得急救医疗服务以及出血事件可能造成的损害。这构成了重大的安全风险，需要医生在批准前进行评估。
Recognize that 'prolonged immobility' is a primary risk factor for DVT. Discharging an acute DVT patient back into a high-risk environment without medical clearance is unsafe.
认识到“长时间不动”是 DVT 的主要危险因素。在没有医疗许可的情况下让急性 DVT 患者出院回到高风险环境是不安全的。

stem.en: Read the case study and answer the questions that follow.
stem.zh: 阅读案例研究并回答以下问题。

title.en: Advance directive clarification and code status escalation in metastatic lung cancer with acute respiratory decline.
title.zh: 伴有急性呼吸衰退的转移性肺癌中的预立医疗指示澄清和抢救状态升级。

summary.en: Mr. Harold Jeffries is a 55-year-old man admitted five days ago to a medical-surgical unit with progressive dyspnea and right-sided pleural effusion secondary to metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (stage IV). He is receiving palliative carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Current orders include supplemental oxygen via nasal cannula titrated to maintain SpO₂ > 92%. The attending is a pulmonologist currently in the OR; the covering provider is a hospitalist. The medical record contains no advance directive, POLST, or healthcare power of attorney. The code status is 'Full Code' (default). His daughter Keisha is the emergency contact. At 0700, he states unprompted: 'I've been thinking about this all night. I don't want to be kept alive by machines. If something happens, I don't want them to put a tube down my throat... I just want to be comfortable.'
summary.zh: Harold Jeffries 先生是一位 55 岁的男性，五天前因转移性非小细胞肺癌（IV期）继发的进行性呼吸困难和右侧胸腔积液收治于内外科病房。他正在接受以卡铂为基础的姑息性化疗。目前的医嘱包括通过鼻导管吸氧以维持 SpO₂ > 92%。主治医生是目前在手术室的呼吸科医生；代班医生是住院医师。病历中没有预立医疗指示、维持生命治疗医生医嘱（POLST）或医疗委托书。抢救状态为“全面抢救 (Full Code)”（默认）。他的女儿 Keisha 是紧急联系人。在 0700，他自发地说道：“我整晚都在想这件事。我不想靠机器维持生命。如果发生什么事，我不想他们把管子插进我喉咙里……我只想舒舒服服的。”

title.zh: 初步评估与实验室检查 (0700)

content.en:
Vital Signs:
Temperature: 98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
Heart rate: 92 bpm
Blood pressure: 118/72 mmHg
Respiratory rate: 20 breaths/min
SpO₂: 93% on 3 L nasal cannula

Assessment:
Alert, oriented to person, place, time, situation.
Conversational, assesses with full decision-making capacity.
Respirations mildly labored with accessory muscle use at rest.
Diminished breath sounds over right lower/middle lung fields.
Scattered expiratory wheezes in left lung.
Pain: 3/10, right-sided chest wall ache.
Speaks in full sentences.

Labs (0530):
WBC: 3.8 ×10³/µL
Hemoglobin: 10.4 g/dL
Platelets: 112 ×10³/µL
BUN: 18 mg/dL
Creatinine: 0.9 mg/dL
Albumin: 2.6 g/dL
LDH: 680 U/L
content.zh:
生命体征：
体温：98.8 °F (37.1 °C)
心率：92 次/分
血压：118/72 mmHg
呼吸频率：20 次/分
SpO₂：3 L鼻导管吸氧下 93%

评估：
清醒，对人物、地点、时间和情况定向力良好。
能够交谈，经评估具有完全的决策能力。
静息时呼吸轻度费力，伴有辅助呼吸肌参与。
右下/中肺野呼吸音减弱。
左肺散在呼气相哮鸣音。
疼痛：3/10，右侧胸壁钝痛。
能说完整的句子。

实验室检查 (0530)：
白细胞：3.8 ×10³/µL
血红蛋白：10.4 g/dL
血小板：112 ×10³/µL
尿素氮：18 mg/dL
肌酐：0.9 mg/dL
白蛋白：2.6 g/dL
乳酸脱氢酶：680 U/L

content.en: After Mr. Jeffries clarifies he does not want endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, or CPR (but accepts oxygen and comfort meds), the nurse documents his verbatim statements and capacity. At 0745, the attending's office states he is scrubbing for a case and unavailable until 1400. The covering hospitalist, Dr. Reeves, is paged and responds at 0800: 'I am rounding on the other side of the hospital. I'll see him around 1100.' The code status remains Full Code.
content.zh: 在 Jeffries 先生明确表示他不希望进行气管插管、机械通气或心肺复苏（但接受吸氧和舒适药物）后，护士记录了他的原话及其决策能力。在 0745，主治医生的办公室表示他正在为手术刷手，直到 1400 才有空。代班住院医师 Reeves 医生被呼叫，并在 0800 回复：“我正在医院另一边查房。我大概 1100 会去看他。”抢救状态仍然是全面抢救 (Full Code)。

content.en:
At 0930, portable CXR shows a large recurrent right-sided pleural effusion with mediastinal shift and a new left pleural effusion.
At 0945, patient becomes acutely dyspneic. SpO₂ 88% on 3 L. Nurse increases O₂ to 6 L face mask; SpO₂ improves to 90%. 
At 0950, nurse pages Dr. Reeves about the acute respiratory failure and wishes against intubation. Dr. Reeves replies he will come 'as soon as I can.'
At 1030, SpO₂ is 89% on 6 L face mask, RR 30, HR 118, BP 102/64. Patient says between breaths: 'Please... don't let them... put a tube in me.' Nurse switches to non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min; SpO₂ rises to 91%.
content.zh:
在 0930，床旁胸片显示右侧胸腔积液大量复发伴纵隔移位，并出现新的左侧胸腔积液。
在 0945，患者出现急性呼吸困难。3 L吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 88%。护士将氧气增加到 6 L 面罩；SpO₂ 升至 90%。
在 0950，护士就急性呼吸衰竭和患者拒绝插管的意愿呼叫 Reeves 医生。Reeves 医生回复说他会“尽快”赶来。
在 1030，6 L面罩吸氧下 SpO₂ 为 89%，呼吸频率 30，心率 118，血压 102/64。患者喘息着说：“求你……别让他们……给我插管。”护士换用 15 L/min 的非重复呼吸面罩；SpO₂ 升至 91%。

content.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). The RRT arrives. Dr. Anand (critical care fellow) speaks directly to Mr. Jeffries: 'We may need to talk about a breathing tube. Can you tell me what you would want?' Mr. Jeffries responds: 'No tube. No machines. Comfortable.' Dr. Anand enters a DNAR/DNI order. By 1130, social work completes the advance directive with the daughter, palliative care consult is placed, and comfort measures (morphine, non-rebreather) are effective.

stem.en: At 0700, what is the nurse's priority action in response to Mr. Jeffries's statement?
stem.zh: 在 0700，针对 Jeffries 先生的陈述，护士的首要行动是什么？

stem.en: At 0800, after Dr. Reeves indicates he will visit the patient around 1100, which action is most appropriate for the nurse?
stem.zh: 在 0800，当 Reeves 医生表示他将在 1100 左右探视患者后，护士最合适的行动是什么？

stem.en: At 1100, the nurse activates the rapid response team (RRT). What is essential to include in the handoff?
stem.zh: 在 1100，护士启动了快速反应小组 (RRT)。交接中必须包括什么？

options.en: The unresolved code status, the patient's expressed wishes against intubation, his assessed capacity, and the escalation history.
options.zh: 未解决的抢救状态、患者明确表示反对插管的意愿、其经评估的能力以及上报历史。

options.en: Only the clinical data, assuming the RRT physician will review the nursing notes in the chart.
options.zh: 仅包括临床数据，假设 RRT 医生会查阅病历中的护理记录。

options.en: A recommendation that the RRT stand down because the patient has verbally refused treatment.
options.zh: 因为患者已口头拒绝治疗，建议 RRT 撤退。

options.en: A request for the RRT nurse to immediately administer procedural sedation for intubation.
options.zh: 要求 RRT 护士立即给予程序性镇静以进行插管。

correct.en: The handoff must prominently feature the unresolved code status, the patient's clear refusal of intubation, capacity assessment, and escalation history. This information directly determines what the RRT can and should do.
correct.zh: 交接必须突出未解决的抢救状态、患者明确拒绝插管、能力评估和上报历史。这些信息直接决定了 RRT 可以和应该做什么。

byChoice.en: The RRT is needed because the patient requires emergency provider evaluation and symptom management (e.g., dyspnea), and the provider can formally enter the DNAR/DNI order.
byChoice.zh: 由于患者需要紧急的医生评估和症状管理（例如呼吸困难），并且有权限的医嘱开立者可以正式下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱，因此需要 RRT。

byChoice.en: The RRT operates under time pressure and will default to the charted code status without proactive communication.
byChoice.zh: RRT 在时间压力下运作，如果没有主动沟通，将默认采用病历上的抢救状态。

byChoice.en: The patient is actively refusing intubation; preparing sedation for the procedure directly violates his autonomy.
byChoice.zh: 患者正在主动拒绝插管；为该程序准备镇静剂直接侵犯了他的自主权。

byChoice.en: This ensures the patient's voice reaches the decision-makers during a time-critical emergency.
byChoice.zh: 这确保了在争分夺秒的紧急情况下，患者的意愿能够传达给决策者。

testTakingStrategy.en: Choose the handoff approach that provides a complete picture of both clinical acuity and ethical constraints.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择既能提供临床危重程度又能提供伦理限制全貌的交接方法。

stem.en: At 1130, after the DNAR/DNI order is entered, which actions evaluate the effectiveness of the advocacy process? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 在 1130，下达 DNAR/DNI 医嘱后，哪些行动可以评估倡导流程的有效性？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Verifying the DNAR/DNI order is correctly entered in the electronic health record.
options.zh: 核实 DNAR/DNI 医嘱已正确输入电子健康病历中。

options.en: Ensuring the code status is visually confirmed per policy (e.g., wristband, door sign).
options.zh: 确保按照政策通过视觉确认抢救状态（例如腕带、门标）。

options.en: Notifying the healthcare proxy of the clinical deterioration and advance directive.
options.zh: 将临床恶化情况和预立医疗指示通知医疗代理人。

options.en: Filing an incident report regarding the system vulnerability caused by the delayed provider response.
options.zh: 针对因医生延迟回复而引起的系统漏洞提交事件报告。

options.en: Writing a single retrospective note at the end of the shift summarizing the events.
options.zh: 在交班结束时写一份单一的回顾性记录总结事件。

correct.en: Evaluating the advocacy process involves ensuring the order is properly implemented in all systems (EHR, wristbands), the family/proxy is informed, and recognizing system failures (like delayed provider response) for quality improvement.
correct.zh: 评估倡导流程包括确保在所有系统（EHR、腕带）中正确执行了医嘱，通知了家属/代理人，并识别出系统故障（如有权限的医嘱开立者延迟回复）以进行质量改进。

byChoice.en: Visual identifiers are essential fail-safes during emergencies.
byChoice.zh: 视觉标识是紧急情况下的基本失效保护机制。

byChoice.en: Reporting system-level gaps is vital for institutional quality improvement and future patient safety.
byChoice.zh: 报告系统级漏洞对于机构质量改进和未来的患者安全至关重要。

byChoice.en: Crucial to ensure any responding team recognizes the new code status.
byChoice.zh: 这对于确保任何响应小组都能识别新的抢救状态至关重要。

byChoice.en: The proxy must be aware of the patient's condition and the updated care plan.
byChoice.zh: 代理人必须了解患者的病情及更新的护理计划。

byChoice.en: Documentation must be contemporaneous (done in real-time), not retrospective, to serve its clinical, legal, and ethical functions.
byChoice.zh: 文件记录必须是同期的（实时完成），而不是回顾性的，以发挥其临床、法律和伦理功能。

testTakingStrategy.zh: 选择那些体现了在安全、沟通和系统改进方面彻底闭环的选择。

title.en: Clostridioides difficile infection with dehydration and contact-precaution teaching for family visitors.
title.zh: 艰难梭菌感染伴脱水以及家属探视的接触隔离宣教。

summary.en: A 71-year-old woman is transferred from a skilled nursing facility to a medical-surgical unit with a three-day history of profuse, watery, foul-smelling diarrhea. She completed a 10-day course of oral amoxicillin-clavulanate for community-acquired pneumonia six days ago. Her medical history includes type 2 diabetes managed with metformin 1,000 mg twice daily, hypertension treated with lisinopril 20 mg daily, osteoarthritis, and mild chronic kidney disease (baseline creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, baseline eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²). She lives with her adult daughter and son-in-law, who visit daily and assist with meals and hygiene. On admission, the provider orders contact precautions, stool specimen for C. difficile toxin PCR, IV lactated Ringer's 500 mL bolus over 1 hour, then maintain at 125 mL/hr, strict intake and output, daily basic metabolic panel, and oral vancomycin 125 mg every 6 hours per facility protocol for suspected C. difficile infection. Metformin is held pending evaluation of renal function. A Braden scale assessment is ordered every shift.
summary.zh: 一名71岁女性患者因连续3天出现大量水样、恶臭腹泻，从专业护理机构转入内外科病房。她于6天前完成了为期10天的口服阿莫西林-克拉维酸治疗社区获得性肺炎的疗程。既往病史包括2型糖尿病（规律服用二甲双胍1000 mg，每日两次）、高血压（规律服用赖诺普利20 mg，每日一次）、骨关节炎以及轻度慢性肾脏病（基线肌酐1.4 mg/dL，基线eGFR 42 mL/min/1.73 m²）。她与成年的女儿和女婿同住，他们每天来探视并协助进食和个人卫生。入院时，考虑到疑似艰难梭菌感染，医生下达医嘱：接触隔离，留取粪便标本行艰难梭菌毒素PCR检测，静脉输注乳酸林格氏液 500 mL 负荷量（1小时内滴完），随后以 125 mL/hr 维持，严格记录出入量，每日复查基础代谢指标（BMP），并根据机构方案给予口服万古霉素125 mg，每6小时一次。二甲双胍暂停使用，待评估肾功能后决定。每班进行一次Braden量表评估。

content.en:
The patient reports six to eight loose, watery stools per day for the past three days, accompanied by diffuse crampy abdominal pain, poor oral intake, and increasing fatigue. She states she feels lightheaded when she stands and has not been eating well because "everything makes my stomach worse."

**Assessment Findings:** Temperature 100.6 °F (38.1 °C), heart rate 104, blood pressure 98/62, respiratory rate 18, SpO₂ 96% on room air. Weight 64 kg (documented weight two weeks ago was 68 kg). Mucous membranes dry and tacky, skin turgor sluggish over the sternum, capillary refill 3 seconds. Abdomen soft, diffusely tender without rebound or guarding; hyperactive bowel sounds. Perianal skin intact but erythematous. Braden score 15 (mild risk).

**Laboratory Data:** WBC 18.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. stem.en: Based on the assessment findings and laboratory data at Stage 1, which physiological condition poses the most immediate threat to the patient?

stem.en: At Stage 1, the nurse observes the daughter entering the room in gloves but no gown, and the son-in-law entering without any personal protective equipment. Which action should the nurse take immediately?
stem.zh: 在阶段1，护士观察到女儿戴着手套但未穿隔离衣进入病房，女婿未穿戴任何个人防护装备进入病房。护士应立即采取哪项行动？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the daughter asks the nurse if she can use hand sanitizer instead of washing her hands, and whether she needs to wear a gown and gloves if she is 'just sitting in the chair.' How should the nurse respond?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，女儿问护士是否可以使用免洗手消液代替洗手，以及如果她“只是坐在椅子上”，是否还需要穿隔离衣和戴手套。护士应如何回答？

stem.en: At Stage 2, the nurse assesses worsening perianal skin maceration and partial-thickness skin loss. Which intervention is the priority for protecting the patient's skin integrity?
stem.zh: 在阶段2，护士评估发现肛周皮肤浸渍加重并出现部分皮层缺失。为了保护患者的皮肤完整性，哪项干预措施是优先考虑的？

stem.en: At Stage 3, the provider asks the nurse to evaluate whether the patient's home metformin should be restarted. The patient's eGFR is now 33 mL/min/1.73 m² (baseline 42). Which response by the nurse is the most appropriate?
stem.zh: 在阶段3，医生要求护士评估是否应重新开始使用患者居家服用的二甲双胍。患者目前的eGFR为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为42）。护士最恰当的回答是哪一项？

options.en: "Yes, we should resume it at the previous dose since the eGFR is trending upward."
options.zh: “是的，我们应该以先前的剂量恢复使用，因为eGFR呈现上升趋势。”

options.en: "I recommend holding it for now because the eGFR has not yet returned to her baseline and remains in a caution range."
options.zh: “我建议暂时停用，因为eGFR尚未恢复到她的基线水平，并且仍处于需要谨慎使用的范围内。”

options.en: "We can restart it, but we need to monitor her blood glucose closely for signs of hypoglycemia."
options.zh: “我们可以重新开始使用，但我们需要密切监测她的血糖，注意低血糖的迹象。”

options.en: "Metformin is permanently contraindicated now because her eGFR is below 45 mL/min/1.73 m²."
options.zh: “现在二甲双胍是永久禁忌的，因为她的eGFR低于 45 mL/min/1.73 m²。”

correct.en: Metformin carries a risk of lactic acidosis that increases with renal impairment. Although the eGFR has improved from 24 to 33 mL/min/1.73 m², it has not returned to her baseline of 42. Furthermore, an eGFR of 30-45 represents a caution range where dosage adjustment and close monitoring are required if initiated or continued. Restarting the medication while the patient is still recovering from acute kidney injury and dehydration is unsafe.
correct.zh: 二甲双胍具有引起乳酸酸中毒的风险，该风险随肾功能损害而增加。虽然eGFR已从24改善至 33 mL/min/1.73 m²，但尚未恢复到其基线水平42。此外，eGFR 30-45属于需要谨慎使用的范围，如果在该范围内开始或继续使用，需要调整剂量并密切监测。在患者仍从急性肾损伤和脱水中恢复时重新开始使用该药物是不安全的。

byChoice.en: An upward trend is positive, but the absolute value (33) and the failure to return to baseline indicate that renal function has not adequately recovered to safely clear full-dose metformin.
byChoice.zh: 上升趋势是积极的，但绝对值（33）以及未能恢复到基线表明，肾功能尚未充分恢复以安全清除全剂量的二甲双胍。

byChoice.en: Correct. Holding the medication is the safest approach until renal function approaches baseline and the patient is hemodynamically stable.
byChoice.zh: 正确。在肾功能接近基线且患者血流动力学稳定之前，暂停使用该药物是最安全的做法。

byChoice.en: The primary concern with metformin and renal impairment is lactic acidosis, not hypoglycemia. Restarting it at this point is inappropriate.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍和肾功能损害的主要问题是乳酸酸中毒，而不是低血糖。此时重新开始使用是不合适的。

byChoice.en: Metformin is generally contraindicated when eGFR is below 30 mL/min/1.73 m². At 30-45, it is not an absolute contraindication but requires dose review and caution.
byChoice.zh: 当eGFR低于 30 mL/min/1.73 m² 时，二甲双胍通常是禁忌使用的。在30-45之间，它不是绝对禁忌，但需要复核剂量并谨慎使用。

testTakingStrategy.en: Metformin and kidney disease: remember that poor renal function (especially eGFR < 30) increases the risk of lactic acidosis. Wait for renal recovery before resuming.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 二甲双胍与肾脏疾病：记住，不良的肾功能（特别是 eGFR < 30）会增加乳酸酸中毒的风险。在恢复肾功能之前应等待。

stem.en: At Stage 3, the nurse synthesizes the patient's data to evaluate the response to treatment. For each finding, determine if it indicates clinical improvement or requires ongoing monitoring.
stem.zh: 在阶段3，护士综合患者的数据以评估治疗反应。对于每一项发现，请判断它是否表明临床病情改善，或者是否需要持续监测。

rows.en: Stool frequency of two formed-to-semiformed stools in 12 hours
rows.zh: 12小时内排便两次，为成形至半成形便

rows.en: White blood cell (WBC) count decreasing from 18.2 ×10³/µL to 12.4 ×10³/µL
rows.zh: 白细胞 (WBC) 计数从 18.2 ×10³/µL 降至 12.4 ×10³/µL
eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m²（基线为 42）

correct.en: Decreased stool frequency, a dropping WBC count, restoring urine output, and a normal lactate level all indicate clinical improvement and positive response to treatment. However, an eGFR of 33 mL/min/1.73 m² remains below the patient's baseline of 42, indicating residual renal impairment that requires ongoing monitoring.
correct.zh: 排便频率降低、白细胞计数下降、尿量恢复以及乳酸水平正常均表明临床病情改善且对治疗有积极反应。然而，eGFR 为 33 mL/min/1.73 m² 仍低于患者的基线 42，表明存在残留的肾功能损害，需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Decreased frequency and firmer consistency directly indicate the primary infection is resolving.
byChoice.zh: 频率降低和性状变硬直接表明原发感染正在消退。

byChoice.en: Although still mildly elevated, the downward trend from 18,200/µL is a clear sign of improvement.
byChoice.zh: 尽管仍有轻度升高，但从 18,200/µL 开始的下降趋势是明显的改善迹象。

byChoice.en: Renal function has not adequately recovered to baseline; this deficit requires ongoing monitoring before therapies like metformin can be safely resumed.
byChoice.zh: 肾功能尚未充分恢复至基线水平；在安全恢复二甲双胍等治疗之前，这种功能缺陷需要持续监测。

byChoice.en: Urine output >30 mL/hr confirms that renal perfusion has been restored.
byChoice.zh: 尿量 >30 mL/hr 证实肾灌注已恢复。

byChoice.en: Lactate dropping into the normal range indicates improved systemic tissue perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸降至正常范围表明全身组织灌注改善。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by looking at the trend, not just the absolute number. A WBC dropping from 18,200 to 12,400 is an improving trend, even if it has not yet reached the normal range (<10,000).
testTakingStrategy.zh: 通过观察趋势而不仅仅是绝对数值来评估结果。即使尚未达到正常范围（<10,000），WBC 从 18,200 降至 12,400 也是一种改善的趋势。
